description: Full TVmaze record for ONE TV series by its numeric TVmaze show id — the episode list with air dates, plus network, status and rating. The id is an internal TVmaze number, so resolve it with search_tv_shows first and pass what that returns; when the caller names the show rather than an id, search_tv_shows answers directly.

id.description: TVmaze show ID (e.g., 1 for "Under the Dome")

name: get_tv_show
